name: holymusic
description: Gerador de slides PPTX de letras de músicas com IA local (Ollama) para igreja
author: HolyMusic

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist: electron-vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:nsis: electron-vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:portable: electron-vite build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable
